title: Archive through March 30, 2004 - Anonymous (Thursday, March 11, 2004 - 12:56 pm)
content: I had many "visions". I am not sure of the time frame, as I was ill for some time. I was in a medically induced coma at one point for about three weeks. These could have come then or the months following while sedated in the hospital? Here I go.... From what I've read here on this site, is that my experiences are in the type III - Hellish Experiences. I have so much to share and have never been able to find anywhere to find/share information. The devil was in each vision that I had. He took form of a black Chinese cat. Sometimes he chooses other forms to "trick" me, but he always had to show himself at some point as the cat. He wanted my soul, and badly. In one vision, I remember being tied to a cargo net (much like a spiders web), and he (the cat) was in the corner, and he was waiting for me to submit my soul to him. Each time I began to waiver and say....‘ok, take me, I can't do this any more,’ he would approach and then with renewed strength, I would start reciting that my "soul belonged to Jesus Christ." With that, I became emotionally stronger and the cat would become angry and back away. Sounds weird huh? I've only just begun. I was being held in a black room with a divider half-way between the lengths of the room. The cat (who was taking me to say goodbye) took me to one section of the divided room, and I looked down to the end. There was a window that allowed me to say "good-bye" to my mother, daughter, son and a friend; each person separately. They were crying, and I was telling that it was ok, that I was dying and they would be ok. Everyone accepted this except my friend; she was carrying on about how I couldn't die. The cat then led me to another section that I had not seen before, and it was higher like I had to be elevated to that area. At the top was a "Buddha" that looked at me and said, "Beware of what you wish for." He repeated that saying several times. At that time, the cat informed me that I had two doors from which to choose from. One was of gold gild and the other was a plain door. He opened the gilded door and through it, I could see a large green field with the sun warming it and lots of flowers and children playing and laughing. It looked inviting and fun. I told the cat that I choose that door and wished to go through it. The Buddha again repeated his words. I stepped through the door into darkness and felt myself falling and falling and falling with a panicked feeling of dread, death and hell. The cat was laughing and telling me I choose foolishly. I said that I had changed my mind and didn't want that door and wanted to be with Jesus Christ; that he could be the only being with my soul. I continued to repeat to the devil that "he could have my body, but my soul belonged to Jesus Christ". I found myself at the platform with the Buddha again and the cat was gone. The Buddha again repeated his words’ and I looked at the plain door. I opened it and felt spiritual warmth unlike I had ever felt. I never "saw a light" or anything like others have expressed. But I knew that I was in the presence of the lord. I have lots more experiences with the cat that I had before this one with the Buddha but I'm tired and cannot write anymore.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt 'falling and falling and falling' after stepping through the gilded door into darkness.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A 'Buddha' at the top/platform who looked at the experiencer and repeatedly said, "Beware of what you wish for." Also the experiencer stated they wanted to be with 'Jesus Christ' and later felt they were in the presence of 'the lord' (without seeing a light).
arrival.other_being_detail: The 'devil' appeared as a black Chinese cat, sometimes other forms, but "always had to show himself at some point as the cat."

environment.environment_other_detail: Black room with a divider; a window used to say goodbye to family/friend; a higher/elevated area with the Buddha; two doors (one gold-gilded, one plain); through the gilded door a large green field with sun warmth, flowers, and children playing/laughing; darkness and falling; later the plain door produced 'spiritual warmth'.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: The experiencer rejected the devil/cat's claim and insisted their soul belonged to Jesus Christ; then chose the plain door and felt in the presence of the lord.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Medically induced coma for about three weeks; ill for some time and sedated in the hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated confrontations with a devil figure appearing as a black Chinese cat; a deceptive door-choice sequence; falling into darkness/hellish dread; later opening a plain door and feeling the presence of the lord.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No explicit OBE/tunnel-to-light sequence; instead: black room/encounters, window goodbyes, Buddha warning, door choice with deceptive pleasant scene, step into darkness and falling, return to platform, choose plain door with spiritual warmth/presence of the lord.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Devil repeatedly appearing as a black Chinese cat; being tied to a cargo net 'like a spiders web'; deceptive 'gold gild' door showing a pleasant field but leading to darkness and falling; a Buddha figure repeatedly warning, "Beware of what you wish for."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "soul belonged to Jesus Christ."; "he could have my body, but my soul belonged to Jesus Christ"; "Beware of what you wish for."; "falling and falling and falling"
